name: Python Barcamp Karlsruhe 2027
description: two-day community barcamp for Python developers, sessions planned on site
details:
Fourth Python Barcamp in Karlsruhe at the DHBW, same venue as the 2026 edition and DevFest Karlsruhe. The programme is made by the participants each morning: talks, discussions and hands-on sessions from Python web and data work to AI tooling.

Saturday 9:00-18:15 with a get-together in the evening (19:00-22:30, place tba), Sunday 9:00-17:30. Tram line 1 stops at the venue; parking garage next door.
note: German; barcamp format, evening get-together on Saturday
